terms.ko: lazy: 처음 사용할 때까지 프로퍼티 생성을 미루는 키워드
terms.definition: A keyword that waits to create a property until the first time your code uses it.
terms.example: I made the image loader lazy, so it is not created until the first screen needs it.

terms.ko: Computed Property: 값을 저장하지 않고 읽을 때마다 계산하는 프로퍼티
terms.definition: A property that does not store a value, but calculates it each time you read it.
terms.example: The full name is a computed property, so it always matches the first name and last name.

terms.ko: Property Observer: 프로퍼티 값이 바뀔 때 실행되는 코드
terms.definition: Code that runs right before or right after the value of a property changes.
terms.example: I added a property observer to score, so the label updates every time the number changes.

dialogue.title: Code review: the profile screen is slow
dialogue.setting: Two iOS devs, code review call

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the profile screen opens very slowly. Can you check it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. I found it. The image cache starts when the screen opens, even if nobody needs it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then let's make it lazy. It will only start the first time we use it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good idea. I will mark the cache as lazy right now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did it build?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. I wrote lazy let, and Xcode shows an error.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A lazy property must be a var, because it changes after the first use.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. Now it builds, and the screen opens fast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Also, fullName is a stored string. We update it by hand every time the name changes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe we can add a property observer to firstName, and update fullName there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That works, but I do not like it. We can forget one place.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: True. So what is better?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A computed property. It calculates the value each time you read it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, I see. With a computed property, fullName always matches the first name and last name.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. A computed property has nothing to update, so it cannot be old.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. What about the score label? It sometimes shows an old number.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here a property observer is perfect. It runs when the value changes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the label updates by itself, and nobody forgets to refresh it. I like a property observer for small updates like that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. A lazy cache, a computed property, and a property observer. Small pull request, big win.
I made the image loader lazy, so the app starts faster.
